verdict.rationale: Evidence pack covers Ryzen AI Software (ONNX Runtime, Vitis AI EP, LLM SDKs, NPU/iGPU inference) and general OS support (Windows/RHEL/Ubuntu), but there is no documentation or community evidence about virtualization support, hypervisor compatibility (e.g., Hyper-V, KVM, VMware), or Docker/container workflows on this chip. Missing for 10: virtualization/hypervisor documentation, container runtime support, VM performance benchmarks or hands-on reports.
